description: This file defines the EmployeeEvent entity class for the OrangeHRM HRM system, representing employee-related events stored in the database using Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeEvent
classes.description: Represents an employee-related event entity with properties such as event ID, employee number, type, event, note, created date, and created by, mapped to database table 'ohrm_employee_event' with Doctrine annotations.

methods.name: getEventId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the event.

methods.name: setEventId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the event.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the event.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number associated with the event.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the event.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with the event.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note associated with the event.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the event was created.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the event.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the creator of the event.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the creator of the event.
